To: CUS-0042
Subject: CT-2207: our response to your proposed changes

Hello, and thank you for your markup of CT-2207. Here is where we stand.

Accepted: the 3-year term (clause 2.1). We will come back to you on fixing prices for the whole term.

Counter-proposals:
- Payment (4.1): we can offer Net 45 in place of Net 60.
- Uptime (6.1): we can commit to 99.95%, which matches our 12-month track record, rather than 99.99%.
- Liability (9.2): we cannot accept unlimited liability. We propose a cap of 24 months of fees, instead of the 12 months in our standard terms.

Still under review: the discount notice threshold in 3.2. We will come back to you on it.

Nothing here is final until both sides sign. Happy to talk any of this through.

Best regards,
Priya Raman, CloudCo

Offered terms:

- Uptime: 99.95%
- Liability cap: 24 months of fees
